name: Frost
css: .popover { -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.8); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.8); } .popover, .popover.sheet { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.75), 0 0 0 1px oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.6), var(--docent-shadow); } .popover .arrow { border-color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.6) !important; -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px); backdrop-filter: blur(22px); } .button { border-radius: 999px; } .button:hover { background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.5); } .button.primary { padding-inline: 16px; } .marks i { background: oklch(22% 0.02 255 / 0.16); }
